ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 high-intensity white to low-intensity black ratio across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white intensity across both lobes. Continuous low-intensity black margin along the entire trailing edge. A distinct cluster of high-contrast black pixels is centered at the base of the fluke. Right distal tip exhibits a significant concentration of low-intensity pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped indentation; interior pixel angle approximately 45 degrees; vertical depth is roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jaggedness along the continuous boundary; serrations are more pronounced and closely spaced on the distal halves of both lobes compared to the proximal sections near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the posterior margins tapering to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, roughly circular pixel clusters scattered across the white field; higher density of spots on the right lobe mid-section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, thin diagonal dark lines visible on the left lobe, traversing approximately 10% of the lobe width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jaggedness/irregularity along the trailing edge consistent with physical wear; unique 'block-like' dark pigmentation cluster at the peduncle junction.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of small, isolated black dots forming a horizontal pattern on the lower-left white field of the fluke surface.
